div.div: Role-based guide for Salespersons, AML Officers, AML Managers, Administrators and Clients

tr.td: Annually, or on any change to the AML workflow

div.div: Regulatory context. This system supports 's obligations under the UAE AML/CFT framework (Federal Decree-Law No. 20 of 2018 and Cabinet Decision No. 10 of 2019) for customer due diligence, beneficial-ownership identification, PEP and sanctions screening, and record keeping. It records the workflow; it does not replace the professional judgement of the Compliance Officer.

div.p: The manual is organised by access level. Read Sections 1 and 2 for context, then go straight to the section for your own role. Every action described in a role section is one that role is actually permitted to perform – if a button is not in your section, it will not appear on your screen.

tr.td: Sales access only. No AML group.
Group AML Manager (includes all AML User rights)
No login. Secure emailed link only.
Access rights matrix – who can do what
Client instructions – the KYC web form

div.div: What the module does. When a sale order is approved, the system creates an AML request, emails the client a secure KYC web form (no login required), collects the completed form and supporting documents, routes it through AML Manager review and AML Officer investigation, and blocks project creation until AML/KYC is completed. Every action is recorded in the record's chatter for audit.

tr.td: Salesperson sets KYC Type (Entity or Individual) on the sale order. The field is mandatory – the order cannot be saved without it.
Sale order is approved. The system creates a Draft AML request, generates a unique secure token, pre-loads the document checklist for the KYC type, and emails the form link to the client.
Client fills the 7-step web form and signs it. The AML reference (AML000001…) is assigned on submission, the status becomes New Request, and a 24-hour deadline is set automatically.
AML Manager opens AML > New AML Requests and chooses Accept, Bypass or Cancel.
AML Manager sets the AML Officer on the request. The officer receives an assignment email and the record appears in their pipeline.
Officer clicks Start Investigation; the exact start date/time is stamped on the record. Screening is performed outside Odoo (sanctions / PEP / adverse media) and the outcome recorded here.
Officer clicks No HIT (clean) or HIT Detected (potential match).
If a HIT is detected – or at any point during the investigation – the officer lists the extra documents needed. The client receives a second secure upload link.
Client uploads the requested documents; status becomes Additional Info Received and AML Managers plus the assigned officer are notified.
Approve or Reject. Management, AML Managers and the salesperson are notified as applicable.
Once the request is Approved or Bypassed, the sale order shows AML/KYC Completed and a project can be created for the engagement.

div.div: The AML gate. A project cannot be created for an engagement until the latest AML request on that sale order is Approved or Bypassed. Only a System Administrator can override this, and only with a written reason that is stored on the order (see Section 6).

div.h2: 2. Access rights matrix – who can do what
div.p: Access is controlled by two Odoo groups under Settings > Users & Companies > Users > AML Automation: AML User and AML Manager. AML Manager includes every AML User right, so a manager never needs both. Users with neither group do not see the AML application at all.
div.div: Record-level rule – read this carefully. An AML User can only see the requests where they are named as the AML Officer. The AML Pipeline is therefore your pipeline, not the team's. An AML Manager sees every request regardless of assignment. A newly accepted request is invisible to officers until a manager assigns it.

tr.td: Read + edit own assigned only. No create, no delete.
Read, edit, create and delete all.
Set KYC Type on sale order
Open AML smart button on sale order
AML Gate Override on sale order

div.div: Enforced twice. The manager-only actions are hidden from the screen and re-checked in the server code. Attempting them another way returns "Only AML Managers can accept / bypass / cancel requests" or "Only AML Managers can reassign the AML Officer".

div.p: SALES Applies to anyone who raises and approves sale orders. No AML group needed.

ol.li: Open the quotation and make sure the Customer has a valid email address. Without it the KYC form is never sent and no AML request is created at all.

Set KYC Type, shown as radio buttons just under the customer:
Entity – company, establishment, partnership, trust or any other legal person. Produces the full corporate KYC form including UBO, directors and shareholder registers.
Individual – a natural person. Produces the shorter personal KYC form.
This field is mandatory and drives the entire form the client receives, so take a moment to get it right.
Approve the order as usual.

ul.li: An AML request is created in Draft.
The document checklist for the chosen KYC type is pre-loaded (15 documents for an entity, 5 for an individual).
The client is emailed a branded message with a secure Complete KYC Form button.
An AML smart button appears on the order (visible to AML staff).

div.p: You do not need AML rights to know where a client stands. The sale order carries a read-only AML/KYC Completed checkbox directly under the customer:

ul.li: Ticked – the most recent AML request is Approved or Bypassed. You may create the project and proceed with the engagement.
Unticked – AML is still open, or was rejected or cancelled. Project creation is blocked.

div.p: You will also be emailed automatically whenever a request for one of your orders is Bypassed or Cancelled.
div.h3: 3.4 What to do when the client does not respond

ol.li: Confirm the email address on the customer record is correct.
Ask an AML Manager to use Resend KYC Form Email on the request. Only they can do this.
If the engagement is dropped, cancel the sale order – the linked AML request is cancelled automatically and no further reminders are sent.

div.div: Do not ask for an override as a shortcut. The AML gate exists to keep the firm compliant. An override is an audited exception recorded against your order with the administrator's name, the reason and the timestamp; it is not a way to save time on a slow client.

div.p: OFFICER Group AML User. You see only the requests assigned to you.

Open AML > AML Pipeline. The kanban board groups your assigned requests by status, so your working columns are Accepted, In Progress, HIT Detected and Additional Info Received. Use the search panel filters (New Requests, In Progress, HIT Detected, Additional Info, No HIT, Approved, Bypassed, Cancelled) or group by Status, KYC Type or AML Officer to narrow the list.
If the board is empty, nothing has been assigned to you yet – that is expected, not a fault. Ask your AML Manager to assign the case.
Open the request and work through the tabs:

tr.td: Licence number and expiry, registered and business address, ownership complexity, high-risk jurisdiction answer, payment channels, cash-transaction band, top-5 suppliers and customers, sanctions declaration and all seven PEP questions.
Ultimate beneficial owner identity, nationality, dual citizenship, source of income, whether shares are held on behalf of another person, high-risk jurisdiction exposure and bank details.
Every director with position, nationality, ID/passport number, appointment date and status. Their uploaded ID documents are listed underneath with Preview and Download buttons.
Shareholder register with type, share class, number of shares and percentage holding. Confirm the percentages are complete and that anyone at or above the UBO threshold appears on the UBO tab.
The document checklist. Mandatory items are flagged. Use Preview to read a file in the browser and Download to save it; where several files were uploaded for one line, a pop-up lists them all.
Appears once you have requested additional documents. Shows each requested document, your note to the client, the client's reply note, whether it has been submitted and the uploaded files.
Appears once the client has responded. Contains their free-text notes and the uploaded files.

div.p: The header also shows the client's electronic signature, the signatory's name and the exact date and time of signing.

ol.li: Start Investigation – click as soon as you genuinely begin. The timestamp is your audit evidence of turnaround time, so do not click it in advance.

Perform the screening outside Odoo per firm policy: UN / UAE Local Terrorist lists and other applicable sanctions lists, PEP databases and adverse media, for the client and for every UBO, director and shareholder disclosed.

Record the outcome:
No HIT – nothing found. A green ribbon appears; AML Managers and Management are emailed.
HIT Detected – a potential or confirmed match. A red ribbon appears and the additional-documents wizard opens immediately.
Attach or note your screening evidence in the chatter so the file is self-contained for a regulator or an external auditor.

div.p: Use Additional Documents while the request is In Progress, or complete the wizard that opens automatically after HIT Detected. For each document add a line:

ul.li: Document Name (required) – exactly what you want, e.g. "Updated Trade Licence valid beyond 31/12/2026". Vague names cause a second round trip.
Description / Guidance – the detail the client needs. It is shown both in the email and on the upload page.
Reference File – an optional sample or blank template the client can download.

div.p: Click Send Request to Client / Send Mail. A fresh single-use upload link is generated and emailed. Sending a new request replaces any earlier request the client has not yet answered.
div.div: Request additional documents from In Progress, not from No HIT. Requesting them from the No HIT status moves the record straight to Additional Info Received, and the upload link the client receives will show "Form Expired". If you still need documents after marking No HIT, ask your AML Manager to handle it rather than sending a link the client cannot use.

ul.li: Approve – available from Additional Info Received and directly from No HIT. Marks the client cleared; the sale order's AML/KYC Completed flag is set and the engagement can proceed.
Reject – available from Additional Info Received. Closes the request; the engagement stays blocked.
Print > AML KYC Report – produces the full KYC PDF for the client file. Available in every status except Draft.

div.div: Housekeeping. You cannot delete an AML request or its lines, by design – the audit trail must stay intact. If something must be removed, ask an AML Manager.

div.p: MANAGER Group AML Manager. Full visibility of every request plus all AML Officer rights.
AML > New AML Requests lists everything a client has submitted and nobody has actioned. Open each one, read the submission, then choose:

tr.td: AML due diligence is required – the normal case.
Status → Accepted. Ready for assignment and investigation.
The client is out of scope for AML/CFT customer due diligence under firm policy. Record why in the chatter before you click.
Status → Bypassed, request closed, AML/KYC counts as completed. Management and the salesperson are emailed.
The submission is invalid, duplicated, or the engagement is not going ahead.
Status → Cancelled, request closed, AML/KYC does not count as completed. Management and the salesperson are emailed.

div.p: All three are available only from New Request. Once you have accepted a request you cannot bypass or cancel it from the buttons.
div.div: Bypass is a compliance decision, not an administrative one. It marks the client as AML-completed and unblocks the engagement without any screening. Use it only where firm policy genuinely exempts the client, and always leave the reason in the chatter – that note is the evidence a reviewer will look for.

ol.li: Open the request and set AML Officer in Request Details. The field is visible to managers only.
Saving sends the officer an assignment email and makes the record visible to them – until then, no officer can see it.
Adjust the Deadline if the automatic 24 hours from submission is not appropriate.
Reassign at any time by changing the field; the new officer is notified and the change is tracked in the chatter.

ul.li: AML > All Records – every request in every status, including drafts where the client has not yet submitted. Use the Status / KYC Type / AML Officer grouping to see workload and ageing at a glance.
AML > AML Pipeline – the kanban board across all officers.
Overdue and at-risk records are highlighted in the list view.
You receive the every-two-days digest of requests pending more than one day (Section 9).

div.p: Resend KYC Form Email appears on requests in Draft or New Request. It re-sends the same secure link to the client's email address. Use it when the client says the message never arrived or was deleted; check the address on the customer record first.

ul.li: See and edit every AML request, whoever it is assigned to.
Create and delete AML requests and their lines.
Accept, Bypass and Cancel.
Assign and reassign the AML Officer.
Resend the KYC form email.
Everything an AML Officer can do, on any record.

div.div: Reviewing before approval. Approve and Reject are open to the assigned officer as well as to you. If your policy requires a second pair of eyes before approval, make that a documented supervisory review – the system does not force a separate approver.

div.p: ADMIN Group Settings / base.group_system.

ol.li: Settings > Users & Companies > Users, open the user.
Under the AML Automation category choose AML User or AML Manager.
Leave it blank for everyone else – salespeople do not need an AML group to work with the AML gate on sale orders.

div.div: Never grant AML Manager simply to make a record visible. If an officer cannot see a case, the correct fix is for an AML Manager to assign it to them.
div.p: When AML/KYC is not yet completed, an AML Gate Override tab appears on the sale order for administrators only.

ol.li: Tick Override AML Gate.
Enter the reason – mandatory. Saving without one is refused.
The system stamps Overridden By and Overridden On and tracks the change in the order's chatter.

div.p: The tab disappears once AML/KYC is completed normally. Treat every override as an audited compliance exception and confirm it with the Compliance Officer first.
Settings > Technical > Automation > Scheduled Actions:

tr.td: AML – Send Pending Records to AML Manager
Table of requests pending more than one day, to every active AML Manager.
AML – Send Pending Records to Management
The same table to the company's approver (Management).

div.p: Both are active by default and send nothing when there is nothing pending. "Pending" means status New Request, Accepted, In Progress, HIT Detected or Additional Info Received.

tr.td: Every step of this workflow is driven by email. If the server is not working, requests are still created and logged but clients never receive their form link. Check Settings > Technical > Email > Emails for messages stuck in Exception before blaming the module.
Used to build the secure form links. If it is wrong, every link a client receives points to the wrong host.
Appears on this manual, the KYC PDF, the client portal and every notification email.
Recipient of the bypass/cancel/approve/reject notifications and the weekly digest. Without it those emails go only to AML Managers.
No email on the customer means no AML request is created when the order is approved.
The request, all KYC/UBO answers, signature, status
Preliminary information checklist and its files

div.h2: 7. Instructions for the Client – the KYC web form
div.p: CLIENT No login or password. Give this section to the client if they need help.

The client receives an email from with a Complete KYC Form button. The link is unique to them and needs no account. It stays open until the form is submitted; afterwards it shows "Form Expired", which is normal and means the submission was received.
Progress is saved page by page, so the form can be closed and resumed from the same link.

tr.td: Read-only introduction explaining the purpose of the form and what to have ready before starting.

Entity: name, legal type, trading name, incorporation date and place, registration authority, licence number and expiry, registered and business addresses, industry and activities, source of wealth, ownership complexity, high-risk jurisdiction exposure, payment channels used, cash band, top five suppliers and customers, contact person, parent company, sanctions declaration and PEP questions.
Individual: full name, gender, nationality, date and place of birth, ID type and number, issuing country and validity, addresses, contact details, proof-of-address type and date, verification method, purpose of the relationship, expected transactions and turnover, source of funds, dual citizenship, high-net-worth status and bank details.

The Ultimate Beneficial Owner: name, nationality, date and place of birth, dual citizenship, source of income, whether shares are held on behalf of someone else, addresses, contact details and bank details. (Entity forms only.)

One row per director, manager or secretary – name, position, nationality, ID/passport number, appointment date and status – plus their ID documents. State the date the register is accurate as of. (Entity forms only.)

One row per shareholder – name, nationality, individual or corporate, passport number, share class, number of shares, percentage held and date of entry – plus supporting documents. The percentages should account for the whole shareholding. (Entity forms only.)
Upload the checklist in Section 10. Mandatory items are marked; several files can be attached to one item, and a file can be removed and replaced before submitting.
Check the summary, tick the declaration, type the signatory's name and designation, and sign – either drawn on screen or uploaded as an image. Then submit.

ul.li: A confirmation page shows the AML reference number – keep it for any queries.
The form link stops working; the compliance team now has the submission.
If more information is needed, a second email arrives with an Upload Additional Documents link listing exactly what is required, with guidance notes and any sample file provided.
On that page: upload against each item, add a note if helpful, then submit. That link is also single-use.

div.div: Before you start. Have scanned copies ready as PDF or image files, make sure proof-of-address documents are dated within the last three months, and check that identity documents are still valid.

tr.td: Request created, form sent, client has not submitted yet. Visible to AML Managers in All Records only.
Wait; or Resend KYC Form Email
Client has completed and signed the form. AML reference and 24-hour deadline assigned.
AML due diligence is required and the case is ready to work.
Investigation under way; start date and time recorded.
No HIT / HIT Detected / Additional Documents
Screening found nothing against the client or its principals.
A potential match was found; additional documents have been requested.
Client has supplied the requested documents.
AML/KYC cleared. The sale order shows AML/KYC Completed and a project can be created.
AML/KYC failed. The engagement stays blocked.
Manager determined no AML check is required. Counts as AML/KYC completed.
Request cancelled, or the sale order was cancelled. Does not count as completed.

div.div: Ribbons. The form view shows a coloured ribbon for No HIT Detected, HIT Detected, Approved, Rejected, Bypassed and Cancelled, so the outcome is visible without reading the status field.

div.p: Every notification is generated by the system – there is nothing to send by hand. All of them use the KGRN branded template with the company logo.

tr.td: List of documents, guidance notes, sample files, upload link
Additional info requested from No HIT
Every 2 days – pending more than 1 day
Table: reference, client, KYC type, status, deadline

div.div: "Management" means the user set as the company's approver. If that is not configured, those notifications reach AML Managers only.

div.p: The checklist is loaded automatically from the KYC Type on the sale order. M marks a mandatory item.

tr.td: Latest copy of all branch licences (if any)
UAE VAT & Corporate Tax registration certificate
Certificate of incumbency / good standing – either one is accepted
Board resolution authorising the appointment of the auditor
Organisational / group chart up to the UBO
Business profile / description of business activities
List of authorised signatories – use the Excel format provided; details must match the supporting documents
Family book issued by the UAE Government (UAE nationals)
Declaration – shareholders / managers residing together – only if a shareholder lives with family and has no separate proof of residence
Licence copies of related parties / parent companies (if applicable)
Proof of residence – utility bill, lease agreement or bank statement issued within the last 3 months showing the individual's address
Profile information / résumé / CV with photograph

ul.li: Identity documents for each director / manager listed.
Identity or incorporation documents for each shareholder listed.
The signed declaration and the signatory's electronic signature.
Anything additionally requested by the AML Officer during the investigation.

tr.td: No AML request was created when the order was approved
The customer has no email address. Add one and ask an AML Manager to resend, or re-approve the order.
Client says the KYC email never arrived

Check the spam folder and the address on the customer record, then use Resend KYC Form Email (AML Manager). If nothing at all is being delivered firm-wide, the outgoing mail server is the likely cause – see Section 6.4.
Normal after submission – the link is single use. If they have not submitted, they may be using an older email; resend the link.
An AML Officer cannot see a request
Officers only see records assigned to them. An AML Manager must set the AML Officer field. Do not fix this by granting AML Manager.
Accept / Bypass / Cancel buttons are missing
They exist only in New Request and only for AML Managers.
Approve is greyed out or missing
Approve is available from Additional Info Received and from No HIT only. From In Progress, record the screening outcome first.
Additional-documents link shows "Form Expired" for the client
The request was moved to Additional Info Received – this happens when additional documents are requested from the No HIT status. Request additional documents from In Progress instead (Section 4.4).
"Cannot create a project … AML/KYC has not been marked Completed"
Working as designed. Complete AML (Approved or Bypassed), or have an administrator record an override with a reason.
"Only Administrators can override the AML/KYC completion gate"
The override is restricted to the Settings group. Raise it with IT and the Compliance Officer.
"Enter a reason before overriding the AML/KYC gate"
The reason field is mandatory. Fill it in and save again.
An officer cannot delete a request or a line
By design – the audit trail must stay intact. Ask an AML Manager.
It defaults to 24 hours after the client's submission. An AML Officer or Manager can change it on the request.
Nothing may be pending, or the scheduled actions are inactive – check Section 6.3. The weekly digest also needs the company approver to be set.
Know Your Customer – the identification and verification of a client before and during the business relationship.
Ultimate Beneficial Owner – the natural person who ultimately owns or controls the client.
Politically Exposed Person – someone entrusted with a prominent public function, and their close associates and family.
A potential or confirmed match of a name against a sanctions, PEP or adverse-media source.
Screening completed with no match found.
A manager's decision that AML due diligence is not required for this client. Closes the request as completed.
The control that prevents a project being created for an engagement until AML/KYC is completed.
The message and activity log at the bottom of every record – the audit trail.
The secure, login-free web form sent to the client.

div.p: Each user with access to the AML application should confirm they have read and understood the sections relevant to their role.
